en: Color-printed, painterly view of a European city street from an elevated perspective. A broad tree‑lined boulevard leads into the distance, with pedestrians, a tramline, and shops with striped awnings. On the right stands a tall Baroque church tower with an onion-shaped spire and a clock; on the left are richly decorated historicist buildings with domes and smaller spires. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century cityscape illustration. No visible text appears on the image side.
